## ⚠️ Pipeline-level warnings

- ICA is refit in Python. Component order and signs will NOT match EEGLAB, so any hard-coded component numbers later in the script are meaningless. Re-select components (ICLabel or by eye), or run with --ica reuse to load EEGLAB's decomposition.
